india_trends.title: IRCTC Q1 Results: Revenue rises 18%, profit remains largely flat at ₹330 crore
india_trends.summary: IRCTC reported a net profit of 330.16 crore for the June quarter, slightly down from 330.71 crore a year ago. Revenue rose 18.1% to 1,369.53 crore YoY but fell 6.2% sequentially. Tourism revenue declined sharply, while catering showed strong growth.

india_trends.title: Indel Money to raise up to Rs 500 crore via public issue of NCDs
india_trends.summary: Indel Money plans to raise up to Rs 500 crore through a public issue of non-convertible debentures. The issue will open on August 18 and close on August 31, with an option for early closure. Proceeds will fund onward lending, refinancing existing debt, and general corporate purposes.
